description: This file contains a jQuery plugin implementation for timers, including fjTimer, fjTimerEach, and fjFunctionQueue, with usage examples and configuration options.

methods.name: fjFunctionQueue
methods.description: Manages a queue of functions to execute with timing control, supporting auto-start, callbacks, and queue management.

methods.name: fjTimer
methods.description: Creates a timer that executes a callback at specified intervals, with support for repeat counts and steps.

methods.name: fjTimerEach
methods.description: Iterates over an array, executing a callback for each element with timing control.
